title: Synthesis: the Flow-Lenia ecology replicates but its predators graze a recycled film behind a written gate; the waste vortices' novelty stays bounded
summary: Since 01:19Z no claim became established. c62's Flow-Lenia ecology from noise replicates S, I and X, and shows free predator fission, but D is seed-dependent and reticulate. Two reviews mark E by construction: a saturated gate scales the predator's whole growth field. A food-source control shows the predators live mainly on prey matter recycled as a dilute film rather than on prey bodies. In the fed vortices, standard-memory novelty cycles in a bounded region to T=30000; long memory travels on 1 of 4 seeds; sw's effect runs through the per-mutation escape advantage. A distribution-memory waste is running.
